preconditions.description: The integer l must be between 1 and 10^800 inclusive.
The integer r must be at least l and at most 10^800.
The integer n must be between 1 and 2000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must be the maximum number of modest substrings.
The second line of output must be a string of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789' for c in stdout.splitlines()[1])
postconditions.description: The output string must consist only of digits.
